name: UK Sport on TV
description: Which UK channel shows each televised football match, weeks ahead (Sky Sports, TNT Sports, Premier Sports, BBC, ITV, Amazon…), from live-footballontv.com: added to those channels' guides at the time of each match (where the guide has nothing then), and kept in the plugin's settings for players such as Viewarr. Refreshed after each EPG refresh (at most every 6 hours).
author: petebutty

fields.label: Days ahead
fields.help_text: How many days of listings to keep (the source lists a few months; fewer keeps the data small).

fields.label: Add matches to channel guides
fields.help_text: Puts each match on the channels showing it, at its time, where the guide has nothing then (weeks beyond most guides). Never changes the provider's own programmes. Re-added after every EPG refresh.

actions.label: Refresh listings now
actions.description: Fetches the latest UK TV football listings.

actions.label: Show status
actions.description: When the listings were last fetched, how many matches, and the next few.

actions.label: Remove added matches
actions.description: Takes every match this plugin added out of the guide (turn off 'Add matches to channel guides' too, or they come back at the next refresh).

actions.label: After EPG Refresh (automatic)
actions.description: Runs by itself after an EPG refresh; fetches only when the listings are over 6 hours old.
